html:
1The exam at a glance

The PL-300 exam tests the Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst role: you prepare data, model it, build and analyze reports, and manage and secure content. It is an associate-level exam.

Item Fact
Time 100 minutes
Passing score 700 on a scale of 1,000
Delivery Proctored; items may include interactive components
Languages 10; the English exam is updated first, the others about eight weeks later
Credential Associate-level role-based credential
Renewal Every 12 months with a free online assessment on Microsoft Learn
Retake After 24 hours; later retakes wait longer
Content Mostly generally available features; preview features appear if commonly used

Use the current Practice Assessment on AI Skills Navigator. The older practice assessments on Microsoft Learn are no longer updated. Read the study guide page again before you book, because the skills list can change.

Exam tip

. 100 minutes, a passing score of 700 on a scale of 1,000, a retake after 24 hours, and renewal every 12 months with a free online assessment. Renewal is an assessment, not a second exam.

2The four domains and the 11 objective groups

The study guide lists 78 skills. They sit in 11 objective groups inside 4 domains. This course teaches them in modules 1 to 15. Module 0 is this orientation and module 16 is the final review.

Domain and weight Objective groups Modules
Prepare the data, 25-30% Get or connect to data; Profile and clean the data; Transform and load the data 1 to 4
Model the data, 25-30% Design and implement a data model; Create model calculations by using DAX; Optimize model performance 5 to 8
Visualize and analyze the data, 25-30% Create reports; Enhance reports for usability and storytelling; Identify patterns and trends 9 to 13
Manage and secure Power BI, 15-20% Create and manage workspaces and assets; Secure and govern Power BI items 14 and 15

The three large domains carry the same weight. Manage and secure Power BI is the smallest, but its facts are precise and testable: roles, refresh limits, row-level security and labels.

Exam tip

. Three domains weigh 25-30% each and Manage and secure Power BI weighs 15-20%. Do not skip the smallest domain: its limits and role rules are easy to learn and easy to test.

3What is new and where each layer fits

The skills list names several newer topics. Give them extra time if you studied with older material.

Newer topic Module
Choosing between Direct Lake, DirectQuery and Import 1
Calculation groups 7
DAX query view, with Performance Analyzer 8
Visual calculations and Copilot (narrative visual, create a report page, suggest content) 10
Personalization and accessibility 12
Copilot to summarize the semantic model 13

In the latest update only three groups changed, and only slightly: Get or connect to data, Enhance reports for usability and storytelling, and Create and manage workspaces and assets.

Every question belongs to one layer. Naming the layer removes most wrong answers.

Layer Job Examples
Power Query Editor Shape data before it loads Data types, errors, merge, append, pivot, parameters
Model Define tables and relationships Relationships, cardinality, date table, row-level security roles
DAX Calculate inside the model Measures, calculated columns, calculation groups
Report Show and explore Visuals, themes, slicers, bookmarks, drillthrough
Service Share, refresh and secure Workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh, gateway, labels
Exam tip

. Find the layer first. Data types and null values are Power Query, filter context is DAX, a drillthrough page is the report, and scheduled refresh is the service.

4A four-step method for scenario questions

Most items describe a short business situation and ask for the best feature or the first action. Use the same four steps every time.

  1. Find the layer. Is the problem in Power Query, the model, DAX, the report or the service?
  2. Find the requirement words. Words such as "without", "only", "must", "least effort" and "live" decide the answer.
  3. Remove options that break a requirement. An option that needs code breaks "without writing code".
  4. Choose the simplest built-in feature. If two options work, take the one that is built in and needs the least effort.
Words in the question They usually point to
Without writing code A built-in feature, such as a quick measure or a conditional column
Before the data loads The Power Query Editor
Data must not be copied, or live DirectQuery, Direct Lake or a shared semantic model
Only some users see some rows Row-level security, which applies to Viewers
Each viewer changes the visual Personalization
Pixel-perfect or printing A paginated report
Exam tip

. When two options work, the exam prefers the built-in feature over code, a custom visual or an extra tool. Check each option against every requirement word.

5A study plan

Learn each feature by doing it in Power BI Desktop, which is free. Items may include interactive components, so know where each command lives, not only its name.

Phase Modules Practice
1 1 to 4 Clean and reshape a messy file in the Power Query Editor
2 5 to 8 Build a star schema, a date table and measures
3 9 to 13 Build a report with slicers, bookmarks and drillthrough
4 14 and 15 Use a workspace: roles, refresh, row-level security
5 16 Chooser tables, look-alike terms and a practice assessment

After each module, answer its Q&A without the notes. Write one line for every look-alike pair, such as Import and DirectQuery, then repeat the weak ones.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate does not reach the passing score on a first attempt. What is the minimum wait before the retake?

  • AAfter 7 days
  • BAfter 14 days
  • CAfter 24 hours
  • DAfter 48 hours
Show the answer

Answer: C. A retake is allowed after 24 hours, and later retakes wait longer.

S2A data analyst holds the credential and wants to keep it valid. What does the renewal require?

  • AA proctored retake of the full exam every 12 months
  • BAn instructor-led renewal course at a local training center
  • CA written report about recent project work each year
  • DA free online assessment on Microsoft Learn each year
Show the answer

Answer: D. The credential is renewed every 12 months with a free online assessment, not with a new exam.

S3A Date column holds a time part that stops it from matching the Date table. In which layer do you remove the time part before the data loads?

  • AThe model, by marking the table as a date table
  • BThe Power Query Editor, by changing the type to Date
  • CA DAX measure, by converting the date to text first
  • DThe report canvas, by formatting the date on a slicer
Show the answer

Answer: B. Data types are changed in the Power Query Editor, before the data loads into the model.

S4You read a scenario about a viewer who must see only one region's sales rows. According to the four-step method, what should you do first?

  • ADecide which layer the question belongs to
  • BChoose the option that names the most features
  • CRemove the option that needs the most clicks
  • DSelect the option that contains a DAX formula
Show the answer

Answer: A. The first step is to find the layer, because that removes the options from other layers.

S5A scenario says the report author cannot write code and needs a column that tags large orders. Which option follows the method?

  • AWrite a calculated column with a DAX formula
  • BWrite a custom column with an M expression
  • CAdd a Conditional Column in Power Query
  • DAdd a Run Python script step to the query
Show the answer

Answer: C. The built-in Conditional Column needs no code, so the other options break the requirement.

S6How do the four domain weights compare?

  • ATwo weigh 30% each and two weigh 20% each
  • BThree weigh 25-30% and one weighs 15-20%
  • CAll four weigh exactly 25% of the exam
  • DOne weighs more than half of the exam
Show the answer

Answer: B. Prepare, Model and Visualize weigh 25-30% each, and Manage and secure Power BI weighs 15-20%.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

100 minutes.

R2What score is required to pass?

Show the answer

700 on a scale of 1,000.

R3Which domain has the lowest weight?

Show the answer

Manage and secure Power BI, at 15-20%.

R4What are the four steps for a scenario question?

Show the answer

Find the layer, find the requirement words, remove options that break a requirement, choose the simplest built-in feature.

R5In which layer do you merge and append queries?

Show the answer

The Power Query Editor.

R6Name the Copilot topics in the skills list.

Show the answer

Narrative visual, create a report page, suggest content for a page, and summarize the semantic model.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 100 minutes; 700 on a scale of 1,000; proctored; may include interactive components; 10 languages
Credential associate level; renewal every 12 months by a free online assessment; retake after 24 hours
Domains Prepare 25-30%; Model 25-30%; Visualize and analyze 25-30%; Manage and secure 15-20%
Layers Power Query Editor shapes, model relates, DAX calculates, report shows, service shares and secures
Newer topics Direct Lake, calculation groups, DAX query view, visual calculations, Copilot, personalization, accessibility
Method find the layer; find the requirement words; remove options that break a requirement; choose the simplest built-in feature
Study practice each feature in Power BI Desktop; use the current Practice Assessment
